objective: Determine the most plausible signal class and explain the decision from the supplied model and handcrafted-feature evidence only
decision_rules: Start from region Top3 probabilities and window agreement
Compare observed feature medians with each class p10-p90 reference range
Treat overlapping feature ranges as weak evidence, not class signatures
State material conflicts between model and feature evidence explicitly
Use only high, medium, or low for the final confidence level
Do not use provenance or assume facts absent from this input

required_output.final_label: exactly one label present in model Top3
required_output.conflicting_evidence: list; empty when no material conflict exists
